entities.summary: Alan Brown is a Scottish National Party (SNP) politician who served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Kilmarnock and Loudoun from 2015 until 2024. Brown previously served as the SNP spokesperson for Energy and Transport in the House of Commons. He is the candidate for the Scottish Parliamentary constituency Kilmarnock and Loudoun ahead of the Scottish Parliament elections in 2026.
